description: Twenty developer tasks for the Hallpass fixture, written by a Claude subagent after reading the whole corpus (docs, migrations, source and tests) by hand. Labels mark the minimal line ranges an engineer needs to read to do each task correctly and safely; no retrieval or search tooling was run while writing them.
